positions.title: Senior User Experience Consultant
positions.description:
NIMBL is your Trusted SAP Partner.

Based in Colorado, NIMBL is an award-winning SAP consultancy and recognized thought-leader servicing the Midmarket and Fortune 1000. NIMBL provides SAP business transformation (S/4HANA Private, S/4HANA Cloud, Functional, Analytics, etc.) and SAP technical consulting services (HANA, Development, SCP, UX, Testing, Solution Manager, Upgrades/Migrations, Integration, TDMS, etc.) as well as US-based remote SAP Application Managed Services. 

Our business model focuses on creative, cost-effective, and nimble delivery providing maximum value to customers eliminating the traditional chains associated with the inflexible institutional Big-4 behemoths. 

Founded in 2009 and based in Denver, Colorado, NIMBL has experienced exponential growth since inception and established itself as one of the industry's most highly sought-after SAP Trusted Partner.

* Fortune Inner City 100 2017 (#83) 
* INC 500|5000 Fastest Growing Company 2016 (#3279)
* INC 500|5000 Fastest Growing Company 2015 (#1904)
* ColoradoBiz 2014 Top 250 Private Company
* Denver Office of Economic Development and International Trade "Gazelle" 2014
* Colorado Blackstone Entrepreneurs Network Gazelle 2014
* INC 500|5000 Fastest Growing Company 2014 (#1876)
* INC 500|5000 Hire Power Award 2013 (#2 in Colorado)
* INC 500|5000 Fastest Growing Company 2013 (#743)
* Denver Business Journal Fastest Growing Company 2013
* ColoradoBiz 2013 Top 250 Private Company
* Denver Metro Chamber of Commerce Small Business of the Year 2013
* Colorado Company to Watch 2012
* Denver Metro Chamber of Commerce Emerging Business of the Year 2012
* ColoradoBiz 2012 Top 250 Private Company
* Denver Business Journal Fastest Growing Company 2013
* ColoradoBiz 2011 Top 250 Private Company
* Denver Business Journal Fastest Growing Company 2012
* ColoradoBiz “Tech Start-up of the Month” 2011
* Top 250 Private Company (#2 Fastest Growing!) 2011
* Colorado Technology Association 2010 Apex “Rookie of the Year”
